asana-8326299.text:
Asana is hiring a Head of IT Systems Engineering to lead the team that powers how every Asana employee works. Reporting to the Head of IT, this San Francisco-based leader owns the strategy, architecture, and operations behind our SaaS productivity applications, corporate endpoints, identity, and user lifecycle, setting the standards and roadmap that keep every employee secure and productive. You will also influence the way Asana evaluates, adopts, and governs the tools and platforms our employees rely on. You will be responsible for the Client Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Identity & Integrations teams, who deliver this work. This role has one manager level report.
You ask good questions, are confident in not knowing everything, and would rather build with others than go it alone. You are crisp and detail oriented, but comfortable working outside the boundaries when the situation calls for it. You bring a proven record of success, a passion for technology, and, like us, you value hard work and fun in equal measure.
This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
What you’ll achieve
Develop the multi-year vision, roadmap, and architecture for Systems Engineering, aligned with Asana’s business priorities and Asana’s broader AI strategy
Accelerate an Agentified Asana, helping teams across Asana embrace our tools and reduce the friction of manual work.
Partner with leaders across Asana to build and maintain an efficient and effective portfolio of SaaS tools to enable all Asanas to do their best work.
Lead, develop, and grow the Client Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Identity & Integrations teams, including hiring, performance management, succession planning, and career development
Own the strategy and operation of corporate endpoint management, SaaS application management, identity, and the full user lifecycle
Drive IT’s AI strategy, from evaluating and governing platforms such as Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI to building AI agents and automation for onboarding, access requests, support, and compliance workflows
Partner with Security, Legal, and Privacy to set AI usage policies, data access controls, and vendor risk standards, including identity-based access and data loss prevention for AI tools and integrations
Set client platform standards and drive excellence in system performance, patching, and configuration compliance
Partner with IT Support, IT Infrastructure, and Security leadership to resolve issues, reduce risk, and improve the employee experience
Represent Systems Engineering to senior stakeholders, communicating priorities, tradeoffs, and results clearly
About you
10+ years of IT experience, including 5+ years directly leading teams of systems engineers and software engineers in a fast-paced, cloud-first environment
Proven ownership of purchasing, inventory management, and budgeting at scale
Strong, hands-on knowledge of current IAM practices and cloud-based identity, SSO, SAML, and SCIM
Experience with hosted cloud applications, including Okta, Google Workspace, Asana, Figma, and Slack
Experience establishing governance for emerging technology, including AI usage policy, data protection, and vendor risk review
Track record of setting strategy and roadmaps, then delegating effectively while staying close enough to the details to coach and unblockExperience with configuration management and automation tools such as JAMF, Intune, Puppet, and Munki
Working knowledge of scripting and API integration (REST, OAuth, Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent)
Hands-on experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude, and OpenAI, including deployment, administration, and integration through APIs, connectors, and MCP servers
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making
How you work
A strong mix of problem solving and a positive, service-oriented attitude
Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners
Curiosity and a bias toward experimenting with AI in your own work, and the ability to lead a team through rapid change
At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
What we’ll offer
Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.
For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $252,000 - $296,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.
In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

At Asana, security is foundational to our mission of helping teams work together effortlessly. Our Security organization protects Asana’s employees, users, and customers by proactively addressing threats, enabling secure product development, and embedding security into the fabric of how we operate. We partner closely with Engineering, Product, IT, Legal, and Compliance to build and maintain trust at scale.
As a Security Technical Program Manager, you'll be the connective tissue across the entire Security organization, driving the strategy, programs, and operational rhythms that make the team highly effective and externally visible.
This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role. You'll define how Security as a function operates: how it plans, how it measures itself, how it communicates progress, and how it executes on its biggest bets. You won't just run programs, you'll shape the operating model that makes all programs run better.
This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
What you’ll achieve
Lead high-impact, cross-functional special projects that span organizational boundaries, from standing up new security capabilities and maturity programs to company-wide strategic initiatives
Own the Security organization's annual and quarterly planning cycles, translating multi-year security strategy into a prioritized, executable roadmap
Drive the prioritization and communication of security asks across stakeholders, building a unified framework that influences how partner teams plan and prioritize security work
Define and own the Security team's KPI framework, covering risk posture, program health, and strategic goal progress
Build dashboards and reporting cadences that give leadership real-time visibility into what's working, what's at risk, and where decisions are needed
Establish and continuously improve the operating cadences (All Hands meetings, program reviews, OKR check-ins) that keep the organization aligned and moving fast
Act as a thought partner to security leadership on org design, process improvement, and operational scale
About you
8+ years of TPM experience, with meaningful time in a security context (security engineering, GRC, product security, infra security, or similar)
Strong understanding of security with the ability to engage technical teams and communicate clearly to executive stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale, cross-functional programs from ambiguous inception through delivery
Exceptional written and verbal communication, with proven ability to influence without authority at all levels
Track record of operating with high autonomy — you create the structure rather than waiting for it
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making

The AI organization at Asana builds the platform and products that bring AI into how the world's teams work. That includes AI Teammates that take on work alongside people, the orchestration layer that lets agents plan and act across the Work Graph, and the AI platform that every AI feature at Asana runs on. The platform covers model access, retrieval, context, evaluation, and production quality.
We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction across this organization. You will lead the hardest cross-team problems in AI at Asana, make architectural calls that hold up as models and the industry shift underneath us, and help senior leadership shape where AI takes the product next. The scope spans multiple engineering teams across San Francisco, New York, Vancouver, and Warsaw.
This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
What you’ll achieve
Define the technical vision and architecture for Asana's AI Org that includes AI platform, Agent systems and Studio in partnership with engineering and product leadership
Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Security, and Legal to take ambitious AI products from prototype to reliable, trusted enterprise features
Lead strategic initiatives that span multiple teams, such as agent runtime and orchestration, context and memory for agents grounded in the Work Graph, and reliable, cost-efficient LLM inference at enterprise scale
Set the bar for how Asana measures AI quality, including offline and online evaluation, production monitoring, and the feedback loops that turn real usage into better agents
Make and guide high-stakes technical decisions on model and vendor strategy, build versus buy, and shared platform abstractions, and make sure those decisions age well
Influence R&D-wide AI strategy by bringing a grounded view of the model and agent landscape to senior leadership
Mentor staff and senior engineers, grow tech leads across the AI organization, and raise the bar for design and architecture reviews
Represent Asana's AI engineering work externally through talks, writing, and the technical community, and help attract senior talent
About you
10+ years of experience building production software, including significant time as a technical lead whose work spanned multiple teams
3+ years building production systems with LLMs or machine learning, such as agents, retrieval, evaluation, or inference infrastructure
Track record of leading architecture and initiatives across organizational boundaries, with decisions that proved right over time
Hands-on fluency with the current AI landscape, including foundation models, agent frameworks, tool use, and evaluation methods, with opinions strong enough to set direction and flexible enough to change with new evidence
Deep experience with distributed systems and the reliability, latency, and cost challenges of running them at scale
Able to communicate clearly at every level, from design reviews with engineers to strategy discussions with executives, and to bridge product, business, and technical language
Passionate about coaching and mentoring engineers, including senior and staff-level engineers
Experience with multi-tenant enterprise SaaS, and with security, privacy, and data governance for AI systems, is a plus
Deep care for collaboration and an ability to foster an inclusive culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and thrive
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to play a key leadership role in our Developer Productivity group and drive developer velocity and fundamentally change the software development lifecycle with AI. The scope spans across the stack including tooling, frameworks, and infrastructure to provide full leverage in the developer experience for every software developer at Asana. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. Drive critical developer productivity and AI developer tooling projects that impact 500+ developers at Asana
Partner with the Developer Productivity Group Tech Lead to define technical vision and strategy for 6+ engineering teams, all focused towards improving velocity for Asana engineers
Build and align on the roadmap for Asana's development platform to drive faster development lifecycle feedback loops and uplevel how every Asana engineer ships
Own key outcomes like extending the internal tooling engineers use to delegate work to agents across harnesses
Mentor senior and staff-level engineers in Developer Productivity and across Foundations and the rest of the Engineering organization
Act as a resource for team-level tech leads on topics like longer-term technical planning, design & architecture, and prioritizing tech debt
About you
10+ years of experience working as a technical contributor in large-scale products
2+ years of experience at owning a build system, developer environment, CI or equivalent at an organization of 200+ engineers
Experience making and delegating technical decisions that have org-wide impact
Developed a fluency in current AI developer tooling and have strong enough opinions to collaborate with teams and set direction
Passionate about coaching and mentoring engineers of all experience levels

As part of the AI Developer Productivity team, you’ll set technical direction and build the next generation of AI-powered developer tools across editors, IDEs, CLIs, code review, and cloud and local coding agents. This role is based in our New York City office with an office-centric hybrid schedule.
The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Design and build AI-augmented workflows and systems that help coding agents understand the codebase, follow engineering practices, and enable Asana engineers to complete software development tasks faster and with more confidence.
Design and scale autonomous cloud agents that take on complex, multi-step engineering tasks to reduce toil and enable engineers to focus on higher-leverage work.
Build and refine IDE, editor, and CLI integrations that make AI-assisted development feel intuitive in engineers' daily work.
Create reusable agent skills, tools, context, and integrations that teams across Asana can build on rather than reinvent.
Improve AI-assisted code review workflows so engineers get faster, higher-quality feedback before and during review.
Drive adoption of AI developer tools across engineering through usability improvements, measurement, documentation, and enablement.
Set technical direction for the team, balancing experimentation with reliability, maintainability, and long-term platform thinking.
Partner cross-functionally with teams across the engineering organization to understand engineering needs, identify workflow friction, and scale high-impact solutions.
About you
8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of experience leading complex technical projects across teams.
Experience building developer tools, internal platforms, infrastructure, IDE/editor integrations, CLIs, or workflow automation.
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex), or extending coding agents, MCP-based integrations, AI-powered code review systems, or agent skill/tool ecosystems.
Experience building evaluation and quality frameworks for AI-generated outputs.
